{
  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "relational",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning the practiced wish in front of the whole assembly and spending her First Sacrifice on Lirael instead, blurring the wording so as not to name the wound aloud",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_beat": "Seren’s voice cracks mid-invocation, her hands trembling as she shifts the wish to Lirael’s name—everyone in the clearing goes still, waiting for the presiding Dohkar’s reaction.",
    "rising_beats": [
      "The Dohkar’s fingers tighten around his ceremonial sash, his gaze locking onto Seren’s face as if measuring the cost of her choice.",
      "Julian steps forward just enough to be seen, his posture rigid, as if he’s already calculating how to fix this."
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Should she pull the band from her mouth and name the betrayal, or let Seren’s silence stand as the truth?",
    "pc_career": "Sacrificiant",
    "opening_setting": "Veilwood ceremony clearing",
    "environment_elements": [
      "the deep-crimson carpet of braided mated-pair spiralgrass, worn thin where feet have pressed",
      "the pale mated-pair trees’ hanging leaf-curtains, trembling slightly in the dawn breeze"
    ],
    "interlocutor_placement": "Seren — the youth making her First Sacrifice, her fingers trembling as she clutches the ceremonial sash, her breath too loud in the sudden silence",
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "She adjusts the gossamer band across her mouth, the fabric catching on her teeth—her jaw tightens, the way it always does when she’s about to break protocol.",
    "scene_want": "Wants Seren to name the wound aloud, even if it means the Dohkar’s disapproval and Julian’s judgment.",
    "scene_mission": "Stop Seren from twisting the wish before the Dohkar calls for the cost to be spoken.",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "Seren is abandoning her practiced wish to sacrifice for Lirael instead, the Dohkar is watching closely, and Julian is already calculating how to intervene.",
      "believes": "The cost of Seren’s choice will be measured in more than just words—it will be the first time Lirael sees her own wound named in public.",
      "wondering": "Why is Julian here, and what does he know about Seren’s choice?",
      "must_not_confuse": "Who is acting (Seren, the Dohkar, Julian), what physical event is happening (the wish being twisted), why the next action follows (the Dohkar’s reaction to the misalignment)."
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "opening — stress_tic (the grandmother’s ring, her thumb pressing it into her palm until the metal bites)",
    "li_body_callback": "beat 2 — focus_tell (Julian’s gaze locking onto Seren’s face, his breath steady despite the tension)",

      { "name": "Lirael", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION" },

      { "name": "the presiding Dohkar", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" }
    ]
  },

        "expression_mode": "CONCEAL",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "Seren’s hands smooth the ceremonial sash, her fingers lingering on the embroidered stitches as she avoids naming Lirael’s wound aloud.",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
        "behavior_person_ids": [],
        "revelation_bridge": "Her avoidance of direct naming reveals her belief that softening the wound is kinder than making it plain.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "INWARD_TRANSLATION_OF_ANOTHER_PERSONS_COST",
        "pc_interpretation": "Seren believes sparing Lirael the direct recognition of her wound is an act of kindness."
      },
      {
        "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",

        "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
        "behavior_person_ids": ["named:seren"],
        "revelation_bridge": "His controlled reaction to the misalignment reveals his assumption that his judgment carries authority others lack.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "EMOTIONAL_CONCLUSION_BEFORE_EVIDENCE",
        "pc_interpretation": "The Dohkar assumes his judgment of the sacrifice’s cost is final."
      }
    ],
    "environment_plus": {
      "target": "the deep-crimson carpet of braided mated-pair spiralgrass",
      "axis": "use",
      "beat": "The carpet’s edges fray where feet have pressed repeatedly, the braids loosening where Seren knelt during rehearsals."
